source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: Negation data reveal very interesting asymmetries. Verbs are negated with the help of the negative suffix –MA. This suffix occurs quite high in the structure as shown by the ordering in (17b) where it is further away from the verbal stem than the reflexive and passive voice suffixes.
